description: Assam has become India's first state to deploy an AI-driven hospital model. Gauhati Medical College and Hospital now features the world's first contactless remote patient monitoring system. This advanced technology tracks vital signs without physical contact. It aims to improve patient safety and clinical efficiency. The initiative positions Assam as a leader in future-ready healthcare delivery.
body_lead: The facility was formally inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Assam, Himanta Biswa Sarma, marking a defining moment in the state’s healthcare journey, and positioning Assam at the forefront of AI-enabled clinical care in India. The initiative signals a proactive push by the Chief Minister to upgrade Assam’s public healthcare infrastructure to world-class standards.
